results: Version-1 bundles round-trip as readable typed JSON with sanitized records, bounded newest-first selection, filters, counts and nonidentifying source/session context.
No copy or download action exists before preview; exact reviewed snapshot reaches clipboard/download helper and filter/session changes remove the snapshot.
Packaged skill tool references match actual SDK discovery; no browser-log MCP reader, automatic upload, replay or widened scope is claimed.
Expanded bundle and compact collapsed/expanded logs pass six widths, six schemes and 100/200-percent root text.
limitations: Real Codex/ChatGPT file attachment, model adherence, installed skill activation and physical devices remain unqualified.
Bundle observations remain distinct from server receipts; exports contain no server journal or other-device local history.
One final 72-case bundle pass refreshes generated timestamp evidence after the final targeted test capture; identical compact fixture results remain retained.
